items.summary: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw emphasized the importance of building an innovation-driven pharmaceutical industry in India. She highlighted the need for continued investment in research and regulatory reforms to enhance drug development. The industry must focus on maintaining high-quality standards as it seeks to innovate. Closer cooperation between industry and regulators can help sustain momentum during this transition. India has the potential to participate actively in the global innovation ecosystem.

Puravankara Q2 sales bookings surge 62% to ₹2,136 crore on housing demand
items.summary:
Realty firm Puravankara Ltd on Tuesday reported a 62 per cent annual growth in its sales bookings to Rs 2,136 crore during the September quarter on better demand for its residential properties.
In a regulatory filing, the company said its pre-sales rose to Rs 2,136 crore in the second quarter of this fiscal from Rs 1,322 crore in the year-ago period.
Sales area for the second quarter stood at 1.83 million square feet, up 22 per cent annually. Average price realisation increased 32 per cent annually to Rs 11,651 per square foot.
During the September quarter, Puravankara handed over 977 homes totalling 0.97 million sq ft, to customers.
In the first six months of this fiscal, the company has handed over 1,722 homes spanning 1.92 million sq ft.  Ashish Puravankara, the company's Managing Director, said, "Our focus is on scaling the business while maintaining discipline in pricing, capital deployment and execution."
